editorial:
Imagine you are a news reporter who is desperate for a big break. That is exactly where you start in this story. You follow a crew into a sleepy New York town where nothing ever happens, until they stumble upon a scary crime scene. It starts as a simple murder, but once a second body pops up, the reporter smells a huge story. She starts pushing the narrative of a serial killer to get more views, which turns the whole town against each other. It is a great look at how the media can twist the truth just to get famous, and the tense mood keeps you guessing about who the real monster is.

The acting is solid and the mystery keeps you on your toes, though some parts of the middle feel a bit slow. If you love stories about small towns with dark secrets, you will really enjoy this one. It is a tight thriller that does not overdo it with gore. It is a perfect pick for a rainy weekend night.
endingExplained: You find out that the news reporter's obsession with the story actually blinded her to the truth. The big twist reveals that the killer was someone hiding in plain sight all along. In the final scenes, the reporter faces the consequences of her fake news reports as the real killer is finally caught. It wraps up by showing that her hunger for fame caused more pain than the crimes themselves.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves crime mysteries and stories about the dark side of news reporting.
